_comment: Demo plugin config for the offline fixture run ONLY. It is config.example.json with the kickoff baselines filled in for four of the five demo accounts — Solstice Robotics is deliberately left out so the 'progress is unprovable' finding fires. Your real config lives at ~/.leanscale-gtm/customer-health.json.

accounts.name: Cascadia Health Systems
success_criteria: Forecast accuracy inside 10 points by the end of the first year
One agreed stage definition document that survives a quarter without an argument
accounts.notes: Kickoff sentiment reconstructed from the first three recorded calls. They arrived sceptical after a failed internal rebuild.

accounts.name: Northwind Logistics
success_criteria: Speed to first touch under one hour
Routing logic a non-technical operations analyst can read and change
accounts.notes: Signed after a competitive evaluation. The economic buyer at signature was the previous CFO, who has since left.

accounts.name: Bluepeak Analytics
success_criteria: One attribution number the CFO will accept without a follow-up question
accounts.notes: Champion and economic buyer are the same person — flagged as a single point of failure at kickoff, and it turned out to be one.

accounts.name: Ironvale Manufacturing
success_criteria: No duplicate assignment incidents in a quarter
Routing changes made by the customer without a support request
accounts.notes: Two-year contract to April 2027, auto-renewing. Long runway is the reason to fix the defect now rather than at renewal.

champion_definition: The person who spends their own political capital to keep you. Not the day-to-day admin, not the signer.
